name: ShiMamaProtocol executePairBurn without access control
summary: ShiMamaProtocol.executePairBurn(referenceIn,minPull,deadline) is callable by anyone and sizes the pull from the caller-supplied referenceIn; it makes ShiMamaToken.forcePullFromPair move that many ShiMama out of the ShiMama/FlapTaxToken PancakeSwap pair, syncs and burns them. The attacker pulled 1,311,349,143.96 ShiMama (all but 21.54) from the pair and sold 30.78 pre-acquired ShiMama into the collapsed reserve for 14.88M of the pair's quote token, which it sold for 52.98 WBNB.

loss.notes: The ShiMama/FlapTaxToken pair 0x564cb2bae0b35cfc8c77d94d65015fe898f8f927 lost 14,878,507.234647819132575456 of its quote token 0xaff08796 in the anchor transaction: 743,925.36 went to the quote token's own tax and 14,134,581.87 were sold by the attacker into the 0xaff08796/WBNB pair for 52.981232710993276266 WBNB. Only the sold portion is counted, valued at those realised proceeds and the DefiLlama WBNB price; the 30.78 ShiMama the attacker sold into the pair are its own input.

ageReset.description: Direct immutable protocol contract; the owner's initial wiring ShiMamaToken.setProtocol(0x5049d103) (0x44cf1fed04175fa1652973f631ec36e45f0c053916272ffb729f8bb55b2b76b7, block 87272725, 626 blocks later) only makes the deployed protocol operational and supplies no erroneous value.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Verified source for ShiMamaProtocol 0x5049d103 and ShiMamaToken 0xfeb6e1ba (same file contracts/shimama/shimammacopy.sol; Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=56, v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9, optimizer 200; SHA-256 of the protocol's SourceCode dfb59c185e6451798c5b946020153288644ec54c844399a021b90e57a6ef116f): executePairBurn(uint256,uint256,uint256) (0xfcd7d46a) is external nonReentrant with no caller check; pullAmt = referenceIn * pairBurnBpOnSell / 10000 (pairBurnBpOnSell = 10000 at blocks 87272099 and 87295852), capped at the pair's ShiMama balance, then shimama.forcePullFromPair(pullAmt, this) (onlyProtocol), pair.sync(), shimama.burn(pullAmt). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 87295853, index 46; EOA 0xd10880e7591e30a336b28a5855f0ccb4b8c7c8e9 creates 0x4869954f00c876b9b573a2d4b414370e0b56f417, which creates 0xcf7380462b7ca3e9f1717d17372eb093bf87f8d5): inside a Moolah WBNB flash loan, 0xcf738046 pulls 30.778133166465952288 ShiMama from the EOA (log 162), calls executePairBurn(1311349143962870588845510640, 0, ...) which moves that amount pair->protocol (log 163) and burns it (log 165), then sells the ShiMama through the router: the pair pays 14134581.872915428175946684 FlapTaxToken to the 0xaff08796/WBNB pair (log 171) plus 743925.361732390956628772 tax (log 169), and 0x8aaddec27be4bec1bf3b3f9dc322817fb8298425 pays 52.981232710993276266 WBNB (log 175), forwarded to the EOA (log 178). First exercise: eth_getLogs PairBurnExecuted(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) on the protocol, blocks 87272099..87400000, returns only source-1 (every successful non-empty call emits it); the 28 earlier ShiMama transfers pair->protocol (blocks 87282869..87294965) come from the protocol's liquidity paths, not executePairBurn. Artifact: eth_getCode(protocol) 0x at 87272098; keccak256 0xee6e956dd5148c20c9531c3242f58848069f917ebe9eb5c986b5e0a67b578b22 at 87272099 and 87295852; source-2 is its top-level creation (index 4) by owner 0x6c9774431155f0216a58bcd7f87f6da9815a618f, who also created the token (0x678b79559b8710359e0562530ce9a156651e05e94e561f3b93bfb2c958a2115c, block 87271693). Token protocol() is zero until source-5 (block 87272725, index 13, setProtocol 0x0a9d793d by the owner), the initial wiring; pancakePair() reads the exploited pair at 87295852. No proxy or self-destruct path. Deployment supplies the age.

Reviewed loss. eth_call FlapTaxToken(0xaff08796d28d1018f16fc2a76baf401fea647777).balanceOf(0x564cb2ba pair) = 14878507926966645702015898 at block 87295852 and 692318826569440442 at 87295853 (depletion 14878507.234647819132575456, 18 decimals); WBNB balance of the 0xaff08796/WBNB pair 0x8aaddec2 falls from 255061161322898345644 to 202079928611905069378 (52.981232710993276266, matching log 175 to the attacker). Counted quantity 14134581.872915428175946684 (log 171) valued at those realised proceeds: 52.981232710993276266 WBNB x USD 672.632008308351 (source-7) = USD 35636.87.
